articles.summary: NEW YORK, Oct. 21, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Inspired Entertainment, Inc. (“Inspired” or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: INSE), a leading B2B provider of gaming content, systems and solutions, today announced the launch of its Virtual Sports content on the Massachusetts Lottery’s recently launched iLottery platform. Inspired is the first third-party game content provider to launch on the platform, expanding the Lottery’s digital offering with Post Time Payout, Inspired’s virtual horse racing product and a proven top performer within its Virtual Sports portfolio. Post Time Payout is now available to Massachusetts Lottery players through the iLottery platform. The Massachusetts Lottery is one of the most successful lotteries in the world, with a long history of delivering innovative products to players while generating critical local aid for communities across the Commonwealth. articles.summary: NEW YORK, Oct. 27, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Inspired Entertainment, Inc. ("Inspired" or the “Company”) (NASDAQ: INSE), a leading B2B provider of gaming content, technology, hardware and services, announced that it will report financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, after the market closes on Thursday, November 5, 2026. Inspired management will host a conference call and simultaneous webcast the same day at 5:00 p.m. ET / 10:00 p.m. in the UK to discuss the Company's results. Conference Call Information Pre-registration: Analysts and investors who wish to participate in the live conference call must register in advance here . Once registration is completed, participants will be provided with a dial-in number containing a personalized conference code to access the call.
